justification: Both depict at least one upright human figure together with round motifs (concentric circles in A, rosettes in B) and horizontal linear bands, but these are among the most universal motifs imaginable. A is a radically schematic stick-limbed figure fused with a concentric disc and isolated lines, while B is a modelled, naturalistic procession of robed attendants leading a two-humped animal between ornamental borders; there is no shared specific relationship or scene.
